integrity: An unrestricted three-adic proof is supplied. The included standard-library computation is a finite cross-check only. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts distinct residues of classical derangement numbers modulo powers of three only; it does not count index frequencies or treat other primes. Earlier equivalent specialized formulas may exist in unlocated literature.
title: Exact ternary residue-image spectrum of the derangement numbers
